tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Bond paper by day, blue-black by night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The body of the question sheet. Nothing else is raised.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Evidence: test source, traces, terminal blocks.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Ruled lines between rows. Decorative: never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls, dotted leaders, the perforation of a spread. 3:1 or more on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk. The double rule. Fill of the primary button and the sheet header.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels, margin notes and meta on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk. Never below 11px.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill.

tokens.name: call
tokens.usage: Ballpoint blue: the person's own writing. Their answer, a pick they turned on, the Matched mark, links, the focus ring. Text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: on-call
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a call fill.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Highlighter stroke behind the words of the one open question and behind 'First' in the wordmark. A wash in the dark theme, not a slab.

tokens.name: on-mark
tokens.usage: Text on a mark stroke.

tokens.name: mark-bright
tokens.usage: Full-strength highlighter yellow, the same in both themes. Only for the inbox count, the bar beside a Firsthand line in a terminal, and the cover. Never behind text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: miss
tokens.usage: The Did not match mark and its words. Text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and miss-tint.

tokens.name: miss-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Did not match mark.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Ground of a terminal block. Dark in both themes, because a terminal is its own surface.

tokens.name: on-screen
tokens.usage: Text on screen.

tokens.name: screen-dim
tokens.usage: The agent's own output and the title bar on screen.

tokens.name: screen-rule
tokens.usage: Rules inside a terminal block.

families.fact: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: voice-lg
styles.sample: Which of them would still pass?
styles.usage: The question on a sheet. Page titles.

styles.name: voice-answer
styles.usage: What the person said, in call blue. Always italic.

styles.name: voice-md
styles.usage: The task's name in a ledger row. The verdict in words.

styles.name: voice-sm
styles.sample: A check that passes anyway cannot tell done from not done.
styles.usage: Long-form reading text on the site.

styles.name: fact-md
styles.usage: What a run found. Test names, paths, commands.

styles.name: fact-sm
styles.usage: Margin notes: entry numbers, times, paths.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase column heads, margin labels and verdict tags.

styles.name: ui-md
styles.sample: Checked by a run, no model.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner padding of small controls. Gap in a row of tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in evidence blocks and fact lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the margin column and the entry. Padding of a ledger row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of the question sheet. Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Button height and the answer cell: 48px square.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top margin of a page below the folio.

tokens.name: margin-col
tokens.usage: Width of the margin column left of every row on screens 760px and wider.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Everything. The system is square: this only softens the pixel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The outer corners of a terminal block and of a keycap. Nothing else.

duration.note: How long things take. Nothing in the product moves for longer than the print of a result.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: A cell or button answering a press.

tokens.name: dur-state
tokens.usage: Color changes on hover and focus.

tokens.name: dur-stamp
tokens.usage: The verdict mark landing on the perforation.

tokens.name: dur-line
tokens.usage: One printed line of the run, and one leader.

tokens.name: dur-stroke
tokens.usage: The highlighter passing behind the question.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between successive printed lines and between tally cells.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: the stroke, a printed line.

tokens.name: ease-stamp
tokens.usage: The verdict mark only. A small overshoot, like a stamp settling.

tokens.name: ease-pen
tokens.usage: The highlighter stroke: slow start, even pass, soft lift.
